delete_protection.description: If set to 'true', the storage batch operation job will not be deleted and new job will be created.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: A description provided by the user for the job. Its max length is 1024 bytes when Unicode-encoded.

job_id.rationale: Job ID is an identifier and does not affect security; only identifies the operation.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project ID is an organizational identifier and does not directly impact security.

bucket_list.description: List of buckets and their objects to be transformed. Currently, only one bucket configuration is supported. If multiple buckets are specified, an error will be returned

bucket_list.buckets.description: List of buckets and their objects to be transformed.

bucket_list.buckets.bucket.description: Bucket name for the objects to be transformed.
bucket_list.buckets.bucket.rationale: Bucket name is required for batch operations but doesn't directly impact security.

bucket_list.buckets.manifest.description: contain the manifest source file that is a CSV file in a Google Cloud Storage bucket.

bucket_list.buckets.manifest.manifest_lo.description: Specifies objects in a manifest file.
bucket_list.buckets.manifest.manifest_lo.rationale: Valid manifest location ensures operations target only explicitly listed objects.

bucket_list.buckets.prefix_list.description: Specifies objects matching a prefix set.

bucket_list.buckets.prefix_list.included.rationale: Prefixes ensure operations are scoped to specific objects, preventing accidental mass operations.

delete_object.description: allows batch operations to delete objects in bucket

delete_object.permanent_object_deletion_.description: enable flag to permanently delete object and all object versions if versioning is enabled on bucket.
delete_object.permanent_object_deletion_.rationale: Permanent deletion removes recovery options and poses a major security risk for data loss.

put_metadata.description: allows batch operations to update metadata for objects in bucket

put_metadata.cache_control.description: Cache-Control directive to specify caching behavior of object data. If omitted and object is accessible to all anonymous users, the default will be public, max-age=3600
put_metadata.cache_control.rationale: Cache control is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

put_metadata.content_disposition.rationale: Content disposition is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

put_metadata.content_encoding.description: Content Encoding of the object data.
put_metadata.content_encoding.rationale: Content encoding is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

put_metadata.content_language.rationale: Content language is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

put_metadata.content_type.rationale: Content type is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

put_metadata.custom_metadata.rationale: Custom metadata is informational and doesn't impact security.

put_metadata.custom_time.description: Updates the objects fixed custom time metadata.
put_metadata.custom_time.rationale: Custom time metadata is informational and doesn't impact security.

put_object_hold.description: allows to update temporary hold or eventBased hold for objects in bucket.

put_object_hold.event_based_hold.description: set/unset to update event based hold for objects.
put_object_hold.event_based_hold.rationale: Unsetting event-based holds can allow premature deletion of objects that should be retained.

put_object_hold.temporary_hold.description: set/unset to update temporary based hold for objects.
put_object_hold.temporary_hold.rationale: Unsetting temporary holds can allow premature deletion of objects that should be retained.

rewrite_object.description: allows to update encryption key for objects in bucket.

rewrite_object.kms_key.rationale: CMEK ensures encryption is customer-managed rather than default Google-managed keys.
